concepts.label: 0300-LEDGFILE-OPEN
concepts.description: A program or procedure segment responsible for opening the ledger file and handling file open status.

concepts.label: 9300-LEDGFILE-CLOSE
concepts.description: A routine or process that handles closing the ledger file and sets application result codes based on the file status.

concepts.label: 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
concepts.description: A routine performed to display the IO status code after an error closing the account file.

concepts.label: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
concepts.description: Procedure to abort the program execution.

concepts.label: Account
concepts.description: A data structure representing an account entity with various attributes such as ID, status, balances, limits, dates, and group information.

attributes.LACC-ID: Account identifier, numeric string of length 11
attributes.LACC-CURR-BAL: Current balance, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CREDIT-LIMIT: Credit limit, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT: Cash credit limit, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-OPEN-DATE: Account open date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-EXPIRY-DATE: Account expiry date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-REISSUE-DATE: Account reissue date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-CURR-CYC-CREDIT: Current cycle credit, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CURR-CYC-DEBIT: Current cycle debit, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-ADDR-ZIP: Account address zip code, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-GROUP-ID: Account group identifier, string of length 10

concepts.label: ACCOUNT-FILE
concepts.description: A file representing account data that is closed by the 9300-LEDGFILE-CLOSE routine.

concepts.label: Account ID
concepts.description: An 11-digit numeric identifier for an account.

concepts.label: Account Record
concepts.description: A record representing an account's financial data including balances and transactions.

concepts.label: APPL-AOK
concepts.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the application state is OK to continue processing.

concepts.label: Application OK Flag
concepts.description: A flag indicating whether the application operation was successful (true) or not (false).

concepts.label: Application Result
concepts.description: Status code indicating the result of attempting to rewrite the ledger file record.

concepts.label: Application Result Code
concepts.description: Code indicating the result of an application operation, where 0 indicates success and 12 indicates failure.

concepts.label: APPL-RESULT
concepts.description: Application result code indicating the outcome of the file open operation; 0 means success, 12 means failure.

concepts.label: BALCAT-FILE
concepts.description: Indexed file with sequential access mode, record key FD-TXN-CAT-KEY, and file status BALCATF-STATUS.

concepts.label: Category Code
concepts.description: A 4-digit numeric code representing the transaction category.

concepts.label: CRD-LINK-RECORD
concepts.description: Data structure representing a card cross-reference record with fields for card number, client ID, and account ID.

concepts.label: DB2 Timestamp Format
concepts.description: A timestamp formatted for DB2 database, constructed from current date components and specific separators.

concepts.label: Disclosure Group Record
concepts.description: A data structure representing a disclosure group record with fields for group key, interest rate, and filler.

concepts.label: FILE STATUS MESSAGE
concepts.description: A message displayed to indicate the file status using the IO-STATUS-04 variable.

concepts.label: Input/Output Status
concepts.description: Status code representing the result of input/output operations.

concepts.label: IO-STAT1
concepts.description: A variable representing the first part of the IO status code, used in conditional checks.

concepts.label: IO-STAT2
concepts.description: A variable representing the second part of the IO status code, used in data movement operations.

concepts.label: IO Status
concepts.description: Status code representing the input/output operation status, set to the transaction file close status on error.

concepts.label: IO-STATUS
concepts.description: Status code representing the input-output operation status, set to LEDGFILE-STATUS on error.

concepts.label: IO-STATUS-04
concepts.description: A variable used to store a formatted IO status code for display purposes.

concepts.label: IO-STATUS-0403
concepts.description: A variable representing a part of the IO status code, used in binary data movement.

concepts.label: Ledger File Record
concepts.description: A record in the ledger file representing posted transactions for accounts.

concepts.label: Ledger File Status
concepts.description: Status code indicating the success or failure of ledger file operations.

concepts.label: Ledgerline
concepts.description: Application associated with the LXB002C program.

concepts.label: LEDGFILE-STATUS
concepts.description: A status code indicating the result of closing the ledger file; '00' indicates success.

concepts.label: LINK-CLNT-ID
concepts.description: Client identifier field in the CRD-LINK-RECORD data structure, represented as a 9-digit integer.

concepts.label: LINK-CRD-NUM
concepts.description: Card number field in the CRD-LINK-RECORD data structure, represented as a 16-character string.

concepts.label: LINK-FILE
concepts.description: Indexed file with random access mode, record key FD-LINK-CRD-NUM, alternate record key FD-LINK-LACC-ID, and file status LINKFILE-STATUS.

concepts.label: LINK-LACC-ID
concepts.description: Account identifier field in the CRD-LINK-RECORD data structure, represented as an 11-digit integer.

concepts.label: LXB002C
concepts.description: A batch COBOL program that functions as an interest calculator.

concepts.label: LXZ009D
concepts.description: A called program or subroutine identified as LXZ009D.

concepts.label: RATEGRP-FILE
concepts.description: Indexed file with random access mode, record key FD-RATEGRP-KEY, and file status RATEGRP-STATUS.

concepts.label: RG-GROUP-KEY
concepts.description: A composite key within the Disclosure Group Record consisting of group ID, transaction type code, and transaction category code.

concepts.label: Transaction Category Balance
concepts.description: A signed numeric value with two decimal places representing the balance for the transaction category.

attributes.format: Signed numeric with 9 digits and 2 decimals

concepts.label: Transaction Category Balance Record
concepts.description: Data structure representing a transaction category balance record with key and balance fields.

concepts.label: Transaction Category Key
concepts.description: Key identifying the transaction category, composed of account ID, type code, and category code.

concepts.label: Transaction File
concepts.description: A file used for transaction processing, which can be opened and closed with status codes indicating success or failure.

concepts.label: Transaction File Close Status
concepts.description: Status code returned after attempting to close the transaction file, where '00' indicates success.

concepts.label: Transaction Record
concepts.description: A data structure representing a transaction record with various attributes such as ID, type, category, source, description, amount, merchant details, card number, and timestamps.

concepts.label: TWO-BYTES-BINARY
concepts.description: A variable representing a two-byte binary value, used in IO status processing.

concepts.label: TWO-BYTES-RIGHT
concepts.description: A variable representing the right two bytes of a binary value, used in IO status processing.

concepts.label: TXNFILE-FILE
concepts.description: Sequential file with sequential access mode and file status TXNFILEX-STATUS.

concepts.label: Type Code
concepts.description: A 2-character code representing the type of transaction category.

attributes.condition: on error sets IO-STATUS to TXNFILEX-STATUS
if APPL-AOK true then continue else error handling

concept.label: Account
concept.description: A data structure representing an account entity with various attributes such as ID, status, balances, limits, dates, and group information.

attributes.LACC-ID: Account identifier, numeric string of length 11
attributes.LACC-ACTIVE-STATUS: Active status of the account, single character
attributes.LACC-CURR-BAL: Current balance of the account, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CREDIT-LIMIT: Credit limit of the account, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT: Cash credit limit of the account, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-OPEN-DATE: Account open date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-EXPIRY-DATE: Account expiry date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-REISSUE-DATE: Account reissue date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-CURR-CYC-CREDIT: Current cycle credit amount, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CURR-CYC-DEBIT: Current cycle debit amount, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-ADDR-ZIP: Account address zip code, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-GROUP-ID: Group identifier associated with the account, string of length 10
